svg.aria-label: Spinifex across three Exoscale instances in one zone, spread by an anti-affinity group. Each has a public eth0 carrying its own Elastic IPs, a private-network eth1 for the cluster mesh, its own block storage volume and its share of the guests. Geneve, NATS JetStream, predastore erasure coding and the OVN raft join them east-west over the private network. This topology is not yet tested.
svg.text: anti-affinity group · one zone · not yet tested
Three Exoscale instances, redundant multi-node install
EXOSCALE ZONE DE-FRA-1 · PUBLIC NETWORK + PRIVATE NETWORK
one security group · one anti-affinity group
EAST–WEST, OVER THE EXOSCALE PRIVATE NETWORK
no Elastic IP is involved · MTU 1500
Guest-to-guest traffic rides Geneve between the nodes' private-network interfaces — it never touches eth0 or an Elastic IP.
Each node carries the Elastic IPs of its own guests. Moving one between nodes is an Exoscale API call, not yet automated.
Three nodes is the smallest cluster that tolerates losing one; the anti-affinity group keeps them on different hypervisors.
